title: Update History
intro: What changed in previous versions of the app.

items: Fixed character spells showing dashes instead of real data (casting time, range, components) in the spellbook.
Fixed deleting a spell from the Known tab — it's now actually removed from the character instead of reappearing.
Paladin and Ranger now get suggested spells during character creation.
Unified the Cleric class translation in the spellbook.
Fixed Ukrainian-language spell search on the character sheet.
Adding an existing spell from the spellbook on the character sheet no longer creates a duplicate.
The filters block and the local-storage banner in the spellbook can now be collapsed/closed.
Fixed an app crash right after creating a character.
Fixed a rare crash when quickly closing a dialog with a text field.
Character creation now suggests starting spells by class automatically, with a separate picker for level-1 spells.
Fixed a duplicated highlighted class/school filter in the spellbook.
Fixed the Ranger class translation in the spellbook.
Reduced app size and improved performance.
Fixed a freeze with no loading indicator when opening the character sheet, bestiary, or spellbook.
Added a loading indicator when switching to these screens, so transitions feel smoother.
Improved crash diagnostics for faster fixes in upcoming releases.
Fixed a permission error when creating a character.
Improved account deletion and error handling.
Fixed ability score limits (point buy / standard array).
Fixed joining a campaign via invite code.
First closed testing release on Google Play.
Create and edit a character offline, no sign-in required.
Bestiary, spellbook, and dice roller.
Google sign-in and cloud sync for character sheets.
Collaborative character sheet editing with other players and the GM.
